WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as tele_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM telescopes
),
observatory_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.tele_count,
    CAST(tc.tele_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
),
avg_share_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM observatory_shares
),
filtered_observatories AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    tele_count,
    share
  FROM observatory_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_value)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(tele_count) as avg_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_value) as avg_above_average
FROM filtered_observatories;
